goals.title: Fix the confirmed YOLO fusion/RViz causes. Deliverable: scripts/hyu-d...
goals.objective: Fix the confirmed YOLO fusion/RViz causes. Deliverable: scripts/hyu-docker fusion and fusion-bg must pass bbox_source:=yolov8 so perception_baseline launches yolov8_bbox_node and routes /yolo_bounding_boxes, and graph_slam.rviz must enable the /cones/viz Fusion Cones display. Tier: HEAVY because this touches ROS launch/RViz integration. Success criteria: C1 RED then GREEN parsed CLI evidence for scripts/hyu-docker showing fusion/fusion-bg before change omit bbox_source:=yolov8 and after change include it in both commands, evidence .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/yolo-rviz-fix-c1.txt. C2 RED then GREEN parsed config evidence for graph_slam.rviz showing /cones/viz Fusion Cones before change disabled and after change Enabled/Value true, evidence .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/yolo-rviz-fix-c2.txt. C3 partial runtime launch-argument evidence showing perception_baseline launch accepts bbox_source and yolo_bbox_topic and cleanup receipt, evidence .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/yolo-rviz-fix-c3.txt. Constraints: smallest production change only; do not modify unrelated files; do not commit unless explicitly requested.
